verdict.rationale: Poly ships a built-in agent that can summarize, explain, and edit or write files directly in your storage. It handles multi-step reading, searching, and writing tasks, and builds a 'second brain' memory from your files and Mind notes, so grounded Q&A, summarization, and drafting are documented. However, nothing in the evidence describes controls over which files or notes the AI can see; the sharing controls cover people, not the agent. Missing for 10: documented controls scoping the AI's data access, independent hands-on corroboration of answer and summary quality, and explicit grounding or citation behavior for Q&A answers.
